listing.name: Gran Turismo Sport — RyGT (mlgprorektm8)
listing.summary: The project documents native Windows play and tests on two hardware configurations. Check its README for the exact gameplay limitations. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own decrypted CUSA03220 dump with update 1.69, plus your own system-module and font folders.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release loader to convert eboot into GTSport.exe locally. Supply your own system modules separately.

warnings: The project documents native Windows play and tests on two hardware configurations. Check its README for the exact gameplay limitations.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
